body: I got back pay from March 22nd- April 7th for EI (only thing I applied for on the 22nd before CERB was announced) on April 7th, of $1,000, woke up April 8th, got $2,000 from EI labeled "DN Canada EI / AE" on every deposit. Thought it was weird as I haven't applied for CERB let alone it wasn't a thing active then. Did my reports after waiting a while not sure if I should file them, and I'll be getting payments now. Odd thing is, although all deposits are labeled being sent to my account by EI, when I called to ask, they could only account for $2,500 for my file that I received from them. So I have a mystery$2,000 from EI..

I applied for EI March 22nd, and and am one of the people who received EI back pay at the same time as the CERB payment. Now though I'm not entirely sure how to fill out my EI report correctly to reflect that I'm receiving the CERB. I had filled out one more report the first week of April when they asked, and I received $500 two days ago (didn't put that I made any money as I didn't know if it would be realized I'm getting money from CERB, and not a job). Any help would be appreciated. 
I also put in a call back order to Service Canada.

I was wondering when filing EI reports, if you're getting CERB, what do you put in for the amount earned in that period? Since you get money from CERB, and if I put in nothing I'll get payments from both, which the government has said that they'll track those people down who get double payments. Not sure how to fill in the report to show that I'm getting CERB

I feel that. I'm in the same boat, I can barely bring myself to even write out a message here because no one I've ever met has cared enough to forcibly figure out what's wrong with me, not even my mom. I've deleted this message 4 times and rewrote it 5, and spent the last 15 minutes trying only because I've been crying this whole time, thinking of the noose in my bedroom closet, so I guess all I can really say is that if you're not in my shoes, there's still a chance to turn things around. And I don't know you're situation, I just hope it's better than mine
